input.overview: Spirit of 76 builds two independent objectives around the center saucer. Completing A-B-C-D-E lights the saucer intermittently for Extra Ball, while clearing all eight drops lights it intermittently for double bonus; finishing both qualifies Special. After double bonus is collected, another drop-bank completion can raise the next saucer collection to 4x bonus.
input.simpleOverview: Complete A-B-C-D-E, then clear all eight drop targets. The center saucer cycles among its lit awards: letters qualify Extra Ball, drops qualify double bonus, and both objectives qualify Special. After collecting double bonus, clear the drops again to make a later lit saucer collection worth 4x bonus.
input.summary: Go to the top until the five letters are complete, then pick off the drop bank from controlled feeds. Watch the saucer lamp cycle and shoot only when the desired award is lit; a premature collect can waste the stronger bonus state.

quickInfo.name: Qualify Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete both the letters and the drops.

quickInfo.name: Collect Award
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the center saucer while the desired lamp is lit.

steps.text: Shoot to the top until A-B-C-D-E is complete.
Clear the eight drop targets from controlled side feeds.
Watch the center saucer cycle and shoot it while double bonus or the desired configured award is lit.
After a double-bonus collect, clear the drops again to qualify a 4x bonus saucer collection.

alternatives.title: Letter-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the low drop-bank rebounds are dangerous.

steps.text: Keep sending the ball through the upper letters and star rollovers.
Build base bonus while waiting for clean side-angle drop shots.
Finish the bank only when the center saucer's stronger award can be collected safely.
Build base bonus with lit rollovers and controlled upper-playfield action.
Complete the drops and collect double bonus at the center saucer.
Complete the drops again and collect the saucer when 4x bonus is lit.

machineSetup: Identify Spirit of 76, Pioneer, New York, or the grouped licensed variant; test A-B-C-D-E, all eight drops and reset, star rollovers, center saucer and eject, cycling lamps, and bonus ladder.
Confirm three- or five-ball rules, Extra Ball and Special awards, saucer timing, and whether drop and letter progress carries between balls on the installed version.
